data.body: RCA confirmed from existing investigation: async gate jobs record a local running handle before handing work to an in-process daemon thread. If the MCP process exits before the daemon reaches its finally block, no terminal index record, REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, or attestation is written; a later poll can only see an orphaned running handle. Fix implemented by making gate_status materialize such past-grace orphaned running handles into a persisted failed diagnostic record with an actionable daemon-stopped error, preserving fail-closed behavior and avoiding a misleading lost-result stale-running terminal surface. RED coverage: tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_async.py::test_gate_status_materializes_stale_running_as_failed_diagnostic failed on origin/main with stale-running before the fix.
